files.desc: Sixty short school-themed text messages, each labeled spam or ham (written for this book).
tokenize(), stem(), and prepare(): a small rule-based stemmer and stop-word filter.
Turns the messages into a bag-of-words count matrix with NumPy.

covers.desc: Understand the processes of stemming and lemmatization.
Tokenizing, stop words, and bag-of-words count matrices.
